regions.finding: Six optically active substrate experiments, each with distinct S/R molecular identity, isolated yield, starting-material ee, product ee, E product geometry, time, and standard conditions.
One cross-coupling experiment of 1x and 1e with (E)-2xe (49%) and competing (E)-2e (17%) as separate targeted outcomes.
ORTEP/X-ray characterization of (E)-2k, CCDC 1877067; retained as characterization context rather than a new synthesis.
A distinct 10 mmol (S)-1f experiment gives (S,E)-2f (50%, >99% ee, 1.124 g) and (E)-8f (1%).

Four independent derivatizations under nitrogen: Petasis methylenation, Sonogashira coupling, mono-Suzuki coupling with 5f/6f = 12/1, and double Suzuki coupling; all printed reagent loadings, solvents, temperatures, and times are structured.

unresolved: The main text does not report the analytical method for Table 4 ee values.

regions.finding: Mechanistic control with 1w: intended (E)-2w is 0%, while 7w is isolated in 14% yield.
Two no-product controls: 1e + 8e gives (E)-2e at 0% with no recovery of inputs; 9a gives (E)-2a at 0% with 87% recovery of 9a.
Two deuterium-labeling experiments: [Dᵃ]-1a gives (E)-2a in 44% without D incorporation; [Dᵇ]-1m gives [D]-(E)-2m in 61% with 99% D at the newly formed labeled group.
Author-proposed oxyrhodation/insertion/1,4-Rh migration/beta-H elimination catalytic cycle, represented once as proposed_mechanism rather than experimentally isolated intermediates.
